summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a $200,000 short-term unsecured loan from The Donald P. Monaco Insurance Trust, where director Donald P. Monaco serves as trustee, part of a series of loans totaling $500,000 principal as of the report date. Interest accrues at 7.5% simple interest per annum, with maturity on June 30, 2026. The Board of Directors and Audit Committee approved the loans. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event such as an acquisition or restructuring.
